hints: Use logarithm laws to combine the right-hand side into a single logarithm before removing logs.
Rewrite $2\ln(x+1)-\ln x$ as $\ln\!\left(\dfrac{(x+1)^2}{x}\right)$, so equality of the logarithms gives $x(2x-1)=(x+1)^2$.
Solve the resulting quadratic, then check each candidate against the logarithm domains $x>0$ and $2x-1>0$ before rounding to 3 decimal places.
